release.releaseNotes:
Shared cloud history and a slower precise graph
• Live phone graph: last 60 seconds, updated every second.
• Detail 2ms and Overview views with labelled time and latency axes.
• 1h, 1 day and Custom now fetch shared cloud-monitor history.
• Cloud recorder checks MQTT every minute, even while both apps are closed.
• Up to 30 days of average/peak RTT; outages stay gaps, never fake 0ms.
• History begins when cloud monitoring was enabled; phone recordings are no longer used.
